definitions.rationale: This is the terminating case of the lpfSpec mathematical recurrence: once F squared exceeds N, the summary is defined to return N.
definitions.text:
rule lpfSpec(N, F) => N
    requires F *Int F >Int N

definitions.rationale: This equation defines the divisible branch of lpfSpec by removing one factor F and recursively summarizing the quotient.
definitions.text:
rule lpfSpec(N, F) => lpfSpec(N /Int F, F)
    requires F *Int F <=Int N andBool N %Int F ==Int 0

definitions.rationale: This equation defines the nondivisible branch of lpfSpec by advancing the candidate factor and recurring.
definitions.text:
rule lpfSpec(N, F) => lpfSpec(N, F +Int 1)
    requires F *Int F <=Int N andBool N %Int F =/=Int 0

definitions.rationale: This macro equation defines the named factorLoop proof term as the translated While and If AST fragment.
definitions.text:
rule factorLoop
    => While(
         Compare(BinOp("*", Name("factor"), Name("factor")),
                 CmpOp("<=", Name("n"))),
         If(Compare(BinOp("%", Name("n"), Name("factor")),
                    CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
            Assign(Name("n"), BinOp("//", Name("n"), Name("factor"))),
            Assign(Name("factor"), BinOp("+", Name("factor"), Int(1)))))

definitions.rationale: This macro equation defines the named solutionModule proof term as the complete translated function AST.
definitions.text:
rule solutionModule
    => Module(
         FuncDef("largest_prime_factor", Params("n"),
           Assign(Name("factor"), Int(2))
           factorLoop
           Return(Name("n"))))
